title: Billing Operations Standard: Allocation of Banked Credit Across Aggregated Service Agreements (Net Energy Metering)
content:
**Standard.** Under a Net Energy Metering rider that allows aggregation, banked credit offsets the offsettable charges of the generating service agreement first, and then of the other aggregated service agreements of the same customer, up to the rider's maximum number of aggregated agreements, in the order of the rider's allocation basis, each up to the offsettable charges of its bill for the same billing period. Agreements of another customer, agreements outside the rider's contiguity rule and closed agreements never receive credit. Under every other rider credit offsets only the generating service agreement.

## Terms used in this standard

- **Offsettable charges of a bill**: the bill's energy charge plus its Power Supply Cost Recovery charge, less any Net Energy Metering credit already applied against that bill.
- **Aggregated service agreements**: the customer's other service agreements, in active or notice pending status on the handling date, that meet the rider's contiguity rule. The rider's figures (whether aggregation is allowed, the maximum number of agreements, the contiguity rule and the allocation order) are those of the rider's credit offset and aggregation terms.

## Who may receive credit

| Service agreement | Receives credit under an aggregating rider |
|---|---|
| The generating service agreement | Yes, first |
| Another agreement of the same customer, active or notice pending, within the contiguity rule, within the maximum number | Yes, in allocation order |
| An agreement of another customer | Never |
| An agreement outside the contiguity rule | Never |
| A closed agreement | Never |

## Hypothetical worked allocation

Hypothetical inputs: an aggregating rider whose order is the generating agreement first and then the others oldest start date first; a bank of 900.00; offsettable charges for the same billing period of 420.00 on the generating agreement, 310.00 on an aggregated agreement started earlier and 260.00 on one started later.

- The generating agreement is offset by 420.00, leaving 480.00.
- The earlier-started agreement is offset by 310.00, leaving 170.00.
- The later-started agreement is offset by 170.00, the rest of the bank; 90.00 of its offsettable charges remain to be paid.

Under a rider that does not allow aggregation, the same bank offsets only the generating agreement's 420.00.
